decision: Prior P2 cached-incomplete/nonfatal retry finding is closed. No new concrete finding in the shown repair.

closure.reason: Cached initialization owns only adapter opening and migrations again. Each request after databaseFor invokes the actual configured seed producer, so a nonfatal incomplete outcome no longer suppresses the next request. Durable completion and done-lock guards stay in the unchanged real producer; no completion flag or result is fabricated.
closure.ownedLifetimeProof: The outer async task is registered synchronously before its dynamic-import await can resume. The post-import assertOpen prevents starting new seed work if close ran during module loading. Once started, the actual producer call and each deadline anchor are in the private per-runtime seedWork set. close first waits cached adapters then repeatedly drains this set before closing their databases, including anchors that may outlive an early-returning caller. Assertions before registration and after seeding prevent dispatch after close. The adapter/migration cache, failed initialization cleanup and sole owner stay unchanged from the original lifecycle contract.
